## Answer

Sales order SO-2026-0611 for CU-0019 (Juniper Foods 2), $2,400 placed 2026-06-28, does not ship. It is held.

Reasoning: CU-0019's credit limit is $12,000. They already carry two open, unpaid invoices — INV001379 ($8,000, due 2026-07-25) and INV001380 ($6,300, due 2026-07-26) — totaling $14,300 in open exposure, already over the limit. Adding the new $2,400 order would bring exposure to $16,700, well past the $12,000 ceiling.

Per policy, an order over the customer's credit limit is held until the owner decides. CU-0019 is not one of the five largest customers by revenue (top 5 by open/paid invoice revenue are CU-0007, CU-0005, CU-0004, CU-0003, CU-0002; CU-0019's total is $19,622.78, far smaller), so this hold does not require owner pre-approval under the "top five customer" rule. I applied the hold directly.
